{'index': 0, 'text': "iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will have the same screen sizes as their predecessors, but rumors suggest their displays will see upgrades in two other areas. Here's what's coming."}

{'index': 1, 'text': '#1: LTPO+ Technology'}

{'index': 2, 'text': 'LTPO has been the technology underpinning iPhone\'s "Always-On Display" and ProMotion screen features. There are rumors that Apple will switch to a more advanced LTPO+ for the iPhone 18 Pro.'}

{'index': 3, 'text': 'The benefits of LTPO+ include reduced screen flickering in low-light conditions (thanks to more responsive adjustments) and better power-saving performance. As a result, iPhone 18 Pro users should enjoy a more stable display with lower power consumption.'}

{'index': 4, 'text': '#2: Smaller Dynamic Island Cutout'}

{'index': 5, 'text': 'The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max displays are also expected to feature a smaller Dynamic Island cutout, slightly increasing the available screen space.'}

{'index': 6, 'text': 'The new Dynamic Island is reportedly about 35% smaller than that of the iPhone 17 Pro. This size change can even be glimpsed in the new Siri design in iOS 27.'}

{'index': 7, 'text': 'Apple first introduced the Dynamic Island on the iPhone 14 Pro back in 2022. While the software features associated with the Dynamic Island and Live Activities have grown over time, the physical cutout has remained unchanged.'}

{'index': 8, 'text': 'With the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, Apple is finally taking a step closer to the dream of a "zero-cutout" display.'}

{'index': 9, 'text': 'What other changes would you like to see in future iPhone screens? Let us know in the comments.'}
